memberships.page_title: Can the Tricuspidal Quartic Be a Keller Leading Image?

statement: A proper rational quartic with ramification degree three is projectively the tricuspidal quartic, because its dual is a rational nodal cubic; the displayed parametrization has ramification factor xy(x-y) and tangent-syzygy type (1,2).
